items.text:
# School trip travel advances

The Meadowbrook Primary trip to the coastal science centre generated 34 travel advance requests in the HR portal. The automated assistant summarised them for payroll and grouped the receipts by teacher. Finance policy requires a supervisor signature on any advance over £400, and Ms. Okafor's group exceeded that limit. Her signed form was uploaded to the shared drive on Tuesday, and payroll confirmed the payment run for Friday. No further action is needed from the helpdesk unless a receipt is disputed.

items.text:
# Train strike reimbursement batch

During the March train strike, Southern Rail cancelled 212 journeys booked through the employee travel system. The helpdesk assistant drafted refund cases for each booking and posted them to the reconciliation queue. Claims under £50 are auto-settled per finance policy, and the remainder were assigned to the three human reviewers on shift. An employee in the Leeds office asked why her case was still open; the ticket stayed with reviewer number two because the receipt was blurred. All affected staff were emailed the refund timeline on Wednesday.
